vitaldrug_p7_23.why: EN: "Also in second chart I am looking at a place where there is an engulf into a CPAZ, and approaching is also a CP" — here "approaching" is a verb (a CP is approaching the area). FA says "و رویکرد هم یک CP است" ("the approach is also a CP"), which is a literal calque with no meaning in Persian and turns the verb into a noun; the sense that price is approaching a CP is lost.
